bull_case: 유리한 사업·자본배분 가정이 유지되면 기준 점수보다 높은 결과가 가능하다.
bear_case: 성장·마진·자본배분이 정상화되고 핵심 불확실성이 불리하게 전개되면 기준 점수보다 낮아질 수 있다.
thesis: Greg Abel inherited a strong capital-allocation system and has operated within Buffett-era discipline: conservative liquidity, intrinsic-value-based repurchases and selective acquisitions. Governance continuity is strong, though the post-Buffett CEO record is brief.

evidence.claim: Greg Abel became CEO on January 1, 2026; Warren Buffett remained Chairman.
The repurchase program requires CEO judgment that price is below intrinsic value after consultation with the Chairman.
H1 2026 repurchases totaled $4.8B, with Q2 B-share average prices around $476–$488.
OxyChem and Taylor Morrison acquisitions used roughly $16.2B of cash consideration/equity value in 2026.

counterevidence: Greg Abel's public CEO track record is less than one year at the cutoff.
The very large cash balance indicates capital deployment constraints.
Acquisition returns cannot yet be measured for 2026 deals.
unknowns: Abel-era acquisition hurdle rates and post-close return targets.
Future role of Buffett in large capital allocation decisions.
falsifiers: Repurchases occur persistently above conservative intrinsic value.
Governance/control disclosures show material reliability failures.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute, material-control failure or undisclosed related-party event is identified in reviewed primary filings.

subscores.rationale: Q2 buybacks were around $476–$489 B-equivalent while modeled Base value is ~$634, ratio below 0.8.
CEO succession was pre-announced and completed Jan.1 2026; filings and controls remain conventional with Abel/Chang certifications.
Decentralized operating model and long history of reallocating capital across industries support adaptability; post-succession sample remains short.
